criterion: Error messages: specific, actionable / misleading UI
description: When another device revokes this device's project access, the open board switches to "This browser isn't signed in to your local Pardner client" although the browser's session is still valid. Clicking Check again then reveals the true state: "Project access revoked; local data remains saved".
expected: A project-level 401/403 (revoked admission) shows the project failure screen with the revocation reason directly; the signed-out screen is reserved for an invalid browser session.
actual: Signed-out screen with agent advice; the real reason appears only after an unprompted Check again.
suggested_fix: In onAuthLost, re-check /session before switching to signed-out; if /session succeeds, show the project error instead.

description: After re-opening Pardner on a device whose project access was revoked, the Welcome screen (Start/Join) appears with no trace of the revoked project.
expected: A note such as "Your access to Billing platform was revoked on <date>; local data is kept. Export it or ask for a new invitation."
actual: The project silently disappears; the person may think data was lost.
suggested_fix: List revoked projects (read-only, with export) on the Welcome/switcher surfaces.

description: On an agent-only device the signed-out screen advises "Ask your agent to open Pardner for you. It runs pardner client open", which fails there with FORBIDDEN "Human authority required". The open identity step also never notices the session was revoked.
expected: "This computer joined as an agent only, so it has no browser access. Open Pardner on your own computer, or link this device with a My device invitation."
actual: Generic signed-out copy whose advice cannot work.
suggested_fix: Expose humanAuthority=false on the unauthenticated config/session error and render a dedicated message.
